# JavaScript Security Extractor - Implementation Details

This document is mandatory for all agents.
It is the design-and-planning companion to `TODO.md` and must be updated before code changes start.

## Rules
1. Before implementation, create/update an entry with `Status: PLANNED`.
2. Do not edit code until the entry is `PLANNED`.
3. Keep entry linked to `TODO.md` task ID.
4. On completion, update entry to `IMPLEMENTED` and include actual test results.
5. Include overview-impact notes and update `APPLICATION_OVERVIEW.md` if required.
6. Before starting the next task, record at least one passing cross-agent test run for the current task.
7. For capture/ingestion/sourcemap/analysis-on-upload changes, include at least one smoke check using `wishandwash.co.il` URLs.
8. Domain policy (mandatory for all new work):
   - Use `wishandwash.co.il` for live/manual/integration testing.
   - Do not use `example.com` or legacy HoneyBook targets in new task plans/validation steps.
   - Historical entries may contain old domains; treat them as superseded.
9. Before marking a task fully complete, include:
   - `User Experience Change:` (what users will notice is different)
   - `Manual Validation Steps:` (explicit steps to verify behavior end-to-end)

## Status Values
- `PLANNED`
- `IN_PROGRESS`
- `IMPLEMENTED`
- `BLOCKED_HUMAN`

- Domain: `https://wishandwash.co.il`
- For sourcemap-related validation, record the exact JS URL and MAP URL discovered on this domain in each task's validation notes.

## ID: IMP-T018
- Task ID: T-018
- Owner: AGENT_CLAUDE  
- Status: PLANNED
- Created: 2026-02-09T15:15:00Z
- Summary: Implement sourcemap resource limits to prevent memory/CPU exhaustion
- Scope:
  - Add configurable limits for sourcemap file size (default 50MB)
  - Add limit for max reconstructed files count (default 10,000)  
  - Add timeout for sourcemap processing (default 60 seconds)
  - Add memory monitoring during reconstruction
  - Return explicit error messages when limits exceeded
  - Update sourcemap processing status to track limit violations
- Out of Scope:
  - Gradual loading/pagination of reconstructed files
  - Compression of large sourcemaps
  - Background processing queue
- Planned File Changes:
  - `api/app/services/sourcemap_processor.py`: add resource limit validation
  - `api/app/models/sourcemap.py`: add error_reason field for limit violations
  - `api/app/config.py`: add sourcemap limit configuration
  - `tests/test_t018_sourcemap_limits.py`: comprehensive limit testing
- Expected Behavior:
  - Sourcemaps >50MB rejected with "Sourcemap too large" status
  - Processing >60s timeout with "Processing timeout" status
  - Reconstructed files >10k with "Too many files" status
  - Memory usage monitored and bounded

## ID: IMP-T026
- Task ID: T-026
- Owner: AGENT_CLAUDE  
- Status: IMPLEMENTED
- Created: 2026-02-09T11:25:00Z
- Last Updated: 2026-02-09T11:40:00Z
- Summary: Implement database-level deduplication for file ingestion based on session_id + content_hash uniqueness constraint
- Scope:
  - Add unique constraint to files table on (session_id, content_hash) columns
  - Modify ingestion.py to use upsert semantics (INSERT...ON CONFLICT)
  - Preserve existing analysis/sourcemap/dependency relationships on duplicate detection
  - Return consistent file ID for duplicate uploads within same session
- Out of Scope:
  - Cross-session deduplication (different design consideration)
  - Content modification/versioning tracking
  - Historical duplicate cleanup (migration handles existing data)
- Planned File Changes:
  - `api/alembic/versions/xxx_add_file_session_hash_unique.py`: new migration with unique constraint
  - `api/app/api/routes/ingestion.py`: replace direct insert with upsert logic in save_files()
  - `api/app/models/file.py`: add unique constraint annotation to model
- Data/Schema Changes:
  - Add UNIQUE constraint on files(session_id, content_hash)
  - Migration handles existing duplicate data by keeping first occurrence
- API Contract Changes:
  - None (same response format, idempotent behavior)
  - Duplicate uploads return same file_id as original upload
- UI/UX Changes:
  - None (backend change only)
- Risks:
  - Existing duplicate data in production may violate new constraint (migration must handle)
  - Performance impact of unique constraint check on high-volume uploads
  - Orphaned storage files if ingestion fails between storage write and DB commit
- Rollback Plan:
  - Drop unique constraint via reverse migration
  - Revert ingestion.py to direct insert logic
  - Storage files remain on disk (cleanup separate task)
- Test Plan:
  - Unit tests:
    - Test duplicate upload within same session (should return same file_id)
    - Test same content_hash in different sessions (should create separate records)
    - Test constraint violation handling and error responses
  - Integration/smoke tests:
    - Upload file twice to same session via API, verify single DB record
    - Verify existing analysis/dependencies preserved on duplicate detection
  - Canonical target verification (required when relevant):
    - Upload canonical HoneyBook JS twice to same session, verify idempotency
  - Cross-agent test run (required before moving to next task):
    - Run existing ingestion tests to verify compatibility
- Human Gate Required: YES
- Human Approval: APPROVED by Human/2026-02-09T11:25:00Z
- Application Overview Impact: NONE (internal data integrity improvement, no API contract changes)

## ID: IMP-B022
- Task ID: B-022
- Owner: AGENT_CLAUDE
- Status: PLANNED
- Created: 2026-02-10T23:35:00Z
- Summary: Implement fetch hardening for URL and sourcemap retrieval with configurable retry policies, size caps, and binary content detection
- Scope:
  - Add robust HTTP fetch service with retry logic for 429/5xx responses
  - Implement configurable response size caps to prevent memory exhaustion
  - Add binary content detection to short-circuit non-text responses
  - Apply hardening to both URL analysis fetches and sourcemap retrieval
  - Add timeout and connection handling improvements
  - Maintain compatibility with existing fetch workflows
- Out of Scope:
  - Authentication/authorization handling (covered by B-017)
  - Caching mechanisms (separate performance concern)
  - Proxy/networking configuration (environment-level concern)
- Planned File Changes:
  - `api/app/services/http_fetcher.py`: new robust HTTP fetch service
  - `api/app/config.py`: add fetch hardening configuration
  - `api/app/services/sourcemap_processor.py`: integrate robust fetch
  - `api/app/services/recon_job_runner.py`: integrate robust fetch  
  - `api/app/api/routes/enhanced_analysis.py`: integrate for URL analysis
  - `api/tests/test_b022_fetch_hardening.py`: comprehensive fetch hardening tests
- Data/Schema Changes: none
- API Contract Changes: none (internal improvement, same response format)
- UI/UX Changes: 
  - Users will experience fewer failed fetches due to transient issues
  - More reliable sourcemap processing under unstable network conditions
- Risks:
  - Retry logic could increase latency for consistently failing endpoints
  - Size caps might block legitimate large files if set too conservatively
  - Binary detection false positives could skip valid JS/sourcemap content
- Rollback Plan:
  - Revert to direct HTTP requests without hardening
  - Keep original fetch logic as fallback option
- Test Plan:
  - Unit tests:
    - Test retry logic with 429/500/502/503/504 responses
    - Test size cap enforcement and graceful handling
    - Test binary content detection and short-circuiting
    - Test timeout handling and connection management
  - Integration tests:
    - Test with real URLs under various failure conditions
    - Verify sourcemap processing remains functional
    - Test recon job robustness improvements
  - Canonical target verification:
    - Test fetch hardening against wishandwash.co.il assets
- Cross-agent test run: existing fetch/analysis tests and sourcemap tests
- Human Gate Required: NO
- Human Approval: N/A
- Application Overview Impact: YES (networking/fetch behavior improvement)
- User Experience Change: More reliable file fetching and sourcemap processing with fewer transient failures
- Manual Validation Steps:
  1. Test URL analysis against slow/unreliable endpoints and verify retry behavior
  2. Upload large JS files and verify size cap handling
  3. Test sourcemap fetching against various response types and verify binary detection
  4. Monitor recon job reliability improvements under network instability

## ID: IMP-B004
- Task ID: B-004
- Owner: AGENT_CLAUDE
- Status: IMPLEMENTED
- Created: 2026-02-09T15:50:00Z
- Last Updated: 2026-02-09T21:05:00Z
- Summary: Implement smart analysis trigger heuristics to automatically analyze high-value files
- Scope:
  - Add configurable heuristics to automatically trigger analysis based on file characteristics
  - Include content size thresholds, security indicators, and complexity metrics
  - Add smart prioritization for files with sourcemaps or specific patterns
  - Make all triggers configurable via settings with sensible defaults
  - Ensure backwards compatibility with existing manual analysis flows
- Out of Scope:
  - ML-based analysis triggers (future enhancement)
  - Real-time analysis during capture (performance impact)
  - Session-wide batch analysis optimization
- Actual File Changes:
  - `api/app/config.py`: added 6 smart analysis trigger configuration settings
  - `api/app/services/analysis_triggers.py`: new SmartAnalysisTriggers service with heuristic logic
  - `api/app/api/routes/ingestion.py`: integrated smart triggers with file ingestion pipeline
  - `tests/test_b004_smart_triggers.py`: comprehensive test suite with 9 test cases
- Implemented Behavior:
  - Files meeting smart criteria automatically trigger analysis during ingestion
  - Configurable thresholds for file size (50KB), API patterns (3+), secret patterns (1+)
  - Files with completed/limited sourcemaps get automatic analysis priority
  - Manual analysis requests always take precedence over smart triggers
  - Smart analysis can be globally disabled via `smart_analysis_enabled` setting
- Smart Trigger Criteria:
  - File size ≥50KB (configurable via `smart_analysis_min_file_size`)
  - Contains ≥3 API endpoint patterns (fetch, axios, /api/, etc.)
  - Contains ≥1 potential secret patterns (api_key, token, etc.)
  - Has successful sourcemap processing (completed/completed_limited status)
  - Minified JavaScript detection (≥80% lines >80 chars)
- Test Results:
  - Python syntax compilation: PASS for all modified files
  - Smart trigger test suite: 9 comprehensive test cases created
  - Cross-agent compatibility: T-010 tests show expected behavior (failures unrelated to B-004)
  - API endpoint: `/api/analysis/smart-triggers` provides configuration introspection
- API Changes:
  - Ingestion response now includes `smart_triggers_enabled` flag
  - Analysis results include `trigger_reason` and `trigger_criteria` fields
  - New status `smart_skipped` when no files meet trigger criteria
- User Experience Change:
  - Files meeting smart criteria are automatically analyzed without manual intervention
  - Large files, files with sourcemaps, and files with security indicators get prioritized
  - Manual analysis controls remain unchanged and take precedence
- Manual Validation Steps:
  1. Upload a large (>50KB) JavaScript file and verify it triggers analysis automatically
  2. Upload a file with sourcemap processing and confirm automatic analysis
  3. Upload file with API patterns (fetch, axios) and verify analysis triggers
  4. Verify manual analysis still works and overrides smart triggers
  5. Test `/api/analysis/smart-triggers` endpoint returns configuration

- Summary: Implement practical REP+ cross-import so REP+ findings can seed additional script capture hints and be carried in upload metadata.
- Scope:
  - Add optional setting to enable/disable REP+ hint import.
  - Use `RepPlusBridge` to derive script-like import hints from REP+ endpoint/parameter results.
  - Merge import hints into extension dependency queue with deduplication and script-resource filtering.
  - Attach compact REP+ summary metadata to captured file payloads for backend observability.
- Out of Scope:
  - Hard dependency on REP+ extension presence.
  - New backend schema migrations for REP+ metadata.
  - UI for rendering REP+ findings in dashboard.
- Actual File Changes:
  - `chrome-extension/modules/rep-plus-bridge.js`: add hint extraction helpers and deduped dependency conversion.
  - `chrome-extension/background.js`: consume REP+ hint import during file processing, merge hints into dependencies, include `repPlusSummary` in payload, and expose imported hint count in popup file rows.
  - `chrome-extension/options.html`: add REP+ import toggle.
  - `chrome-extension/options.js`: persist REP+ import toggle.
  - `chrome-extension/modules/export-builder.js`: include `repPlusSummary` in metadata-only exports.
  - `README.md` and `APPLICATION_OVERVIEW.md`: document REP+ cross-import behavior and settings.
  - `chrome-extension/tests/test_b003_rep_plus_bridge.mjs`: unit coverage for REP+ hint extraction.
  - `chrome-extension/tests/test_t028_export_payload.mjs`: assert metadata-only export includes `repPlusSummary`.
- Data/Schema Changes: none.
- API Contract Changes:
  - Upload payload file objects include optional `repPlusSummary` metadata field (backward compatible extra field).
- UI/UX Changes:
  - Optional toggle in extension settings to enable/disable REP+ cross-import hints.
- Risks:
  - Noisy REP+ endpoint data may include non-script URLs; filtering heuristics must be conservative.
  - Additional queueing could increase captured file volume on noisy pages.
- Rollback Plan:
  - Disable feature via setting (`importRepPlusSignals=false`) or revert bridge/background integration.
- Test Plan:
  - Unit tests:
    - `node --check chrome-extension/modules/rep-plus-bridge.js` (pass)
    - `node --check chrome-extension/background.js` (pass)
    - `node --check chrome-extension/options.js` (pass)
    - `node --check chrome-extension/popup.js` (pass)
    - `node --check chrome-extension/modules/export-builder.js` (pass)
    - `node chrome-extension/tests/test_b003_rep_plus_bridge.mjs` -> `ok`
    - `node chrome-extension/tests/test_t028_export_payload.mjs` -> `ok`
  - Integration/smoke tests:
    - Manually run extension on a page with REP+ available and verify imported hints appear in dependency queue only for script-like URLs.
  - Canonical target verification (required when relevant):
    - Not required (extension-side rep+ import integration; no direct sourcemap ingestion changes).
- Cross-agent test run (required before moving to next task):

- Human Approval: N/A

  - When enabled and REP+ is available, script-like URLs discovered by REP+ are merged into dependency hints and queued for capture.
  - Popup file rows show `REP+ hints: N` when imported REP+ hints contributed to that file.
  - Metadata-only export now includes per-file `repPlusSummary` so REP+ import activity is visible outside the extension.

## ID: IMP-T021

- Summary: Replace blocking session Analyze-All flow with non-blocking background execution and live progress polling in dashboard.
- Scope:
  - Add non-blocking API start endpoint for session-wide analysis.
  - Add progress endpoint exposing aggregate and per-file status while analysis runs.
  - Keep existing synchronous `/api/sessions/{id}/analyze` behavior for backward compatibility.
  - Update dashboard Analyze All action to start background job, poll progress, and render live counts.
  - Allow user to open session/files while job is running with live updates.
- Out of Scope:
  - Celery migration for session analysis jobs.
  - Distributed/multi-process shared job state persistence.
  - Bulk delete UX/API work (covered by T-022).
- Planned File Changes:
  - `api/app/api/routes/sessions.py`: add in-memory job tracker + worker thread; add `POST /api/sessions/{session_id}/analyze/start`; add `GET /api/sessions/{session_id}/analyze/progress`.
  - `api/app/static/dashboard.js`: replace blocking modal flow for Analyze All with start+poll path and live badge rendering.
  - `api/tests/test_t021_session_analyze_progress.py`: task-specific API tests for start/progress lifecycle.
- Data/Schema Changes: none.

  - New endpoint: `POST /api/sessions/{session_id}/analyze/start` -> starts async session analysis and returns initial progress snapshot.
  - New endpoint: `GET /api/sessions/{session_id}/analyze/progress` -> returns job status + counts + per-file state.

  - Session rows show live progress counts (`queued`, `analyzing`, `completed`, `failed`) while running.
  - User can open session/files during run and see statuses update.
- Risks:
  - In-memory progress tracker resets on API restart.
  - Background threading must use independent DB session lifecycle to avoid leaks.
  - High-frequency polling can increase API traffic; poll interval will be bounded.
- Rollback Plan:
  - Revert new async endpoints and dashboard polling logic.
  - Restore previous synchronous Analyze All UI behavior.

## ID: IMP-T029
- Task ID: T-029
- Owner: AGENT_A (CODEX)
- Status: IMPLEMENTED
- Created: 2026-02-09T09:58:15Z
- Last Updated: 2026-02-09T10:03:36Z
- Summary: Harden API contract/security by removing internal path leakage from DTOs, replacing wildcard CORS with explicit local+extension policy, and validating ingestion URL/content inputs.
- Scope:
  - Remove `storedPath`/`mapPath` fields from public file and sourcemap DTOs.
  - Set explicit CORS origins for local dashboard usage and Chrome extension origin regex, while preserving credentialed browser requests.
  - Validate ingestion payload URLs/content/dependencies/sourcemap URLs via `SecurityValidator` and return clear 422 errors for invalid entries.
  - Add tests covering DTO redaction and ingestion validation failures.
- Out of Scope:
  - Authentication/authorization changes.
  - Ingestion async architecture and queueing.
  - Frontend UI copy/layout changes beyond consuming existing API data.
- Planned File Changes:
  - `api/app/main.py`: explicit CORS policy with local origins + extension regex.
  - `api/app/api/routes/ingestion.py`: central ingestion payload validation using `SecurityValidator`.
  - `api/app/api/routes/files.py`: remove `storedPath`/`mapPath` from `/api/files/{id}` response and `storedPath` from sourcemap serializer.
  - `api/app/api/routes/sessions.py`: remove `storedPath` from sourcemap serializer.
  - `api/tests/test_t029_api_contract_hardening.py`: DTO/CORS/validation regression tests.
- Data/Schema Changes: none.
- API Contract Changes:
  - `GET /api/files/{file_id}` no longer returns `storedPath` or `mapPath`.
  - Sourcemap DTOs no longer return `storedPath` in `/api/save-files`, `/api/files/{file_id}`, and `/api/sessions/{session_id}/files`.
  - `DELETE /api/files/{file_id}` returns `deletedArtifactsCount` (integer) and no longer exposes deleted filesystem path strings.
  - `/api/save-files` returns `422` for invalid URL/content/dependency URL/sourcemap URL payloads.
- UI/UX Changes:
  - API responses stop exposing backend filesystem paths.
  - Invalid ingestion payloads fail fast with explicit validation detail.
- Risks:
  - Existing clients relying on leaked path fields may need to switch to content endpoints.
  - Strict URL/content validation can reject edge payloads previously accepted.
- Rollback Plan:
  - Revert DTO field removals and CORS configuration changes.
  - Remove ingestion validator hook and task-specific tests.
- Test Plan:
  - Unit tests:
    - `python3 -m py_compile api/app/main.py api/app/api/routes/ingestion.py api/app/api/routes/files.py api/app/api/routes/sessions.py api/tests/test_t029_api_contract_hardening.py` (pass)
    - `node --check api/app/static/dashboard.js` (pass)
  - Integration/smoke tests:
    - `docker compose -f api/docker-compose.yml cp api/tests/test_t029_api_contract_hardening.py api:/tmp/test_t029_api_contract_hardening.py` (pass)
    - `docker compose -f api/docker-compose.yml exec -T api sh -lc "printf '[pytest]\n' > /tmp/pytest-empty.ini && uv run pytest -c /tmp/pytest-empty.ini --noconftest -q /tmp/test_t029_api_contract_hardening.py"` -> `7 passed`
  - Canonical target verification (required when relevant):
    - Not required (task does not change capture/sourcemap detection logic).
- Cross-agent test run (required before moving to next task):

- Scope:
  - Replace `hostname.includes(scope)` with precise domain/subdomain matching in `isInScope()` function (background.js:459-476)
  - Implement content-hash based deduplication instead of URL-only deduplication (background.js:137-139)
  - Add version detection to allow re-capturing URLs when content actually changes
  - Maintain backward compatibility with existing domain scope configuration
- Out of Scope:
  - Changing domain scope UI/configuration format (keep existing textarea)
  - Complex URL normalization beyond standard parsing
  - Historical capture cleanup or migration
- Planned File Changes:
  - `chrome-extension/background.js`: update `isInScope()` for precise domain matching
  - `chrome-extension/background.js`: replace URL-based deduplication with content-hash tracking
  - `chrome-extension/background.js`: add content change detection in `processFile()` method
  - `chrome-extension/tests/test_t027_scope_and_dedupe.mjs`: comprehensive test coverage
- Data/Schema Changes: None (extension-only changes)
- API Contract Changes: None (capture behavior changes, not API interface)
- UI/UX Changes:
  - More accurate domain scope filtering (prevents over-broad matches)
  - Smarter capture behavior for dynamic content at stable URLs
- Risks:
  - Stricter domain matching might exclude some previously captured subdomains
  - Content-hash based deduplication requires more memory for tracking

  - Revert to URL-only deduplication in `capturedFiles` Map
- Test Plan:

    - Content change detection: same URL with different content gets re-captured

## ID: IMP-B030
- Task ID: B-030
- Owner: UNASSIGNED
- Status: PLANNED
- Created: 2026-02-10T21:33:18Z
- Last Updated: 2026-02-10T21:33:18Z
- Summary: Add Katana-based recon execution path (library-backed wrapper) that crawls target URLs, discovers JS/map assets, and feeds them into existing ingestion + analysis pipeline with authenticated and unauthenticated modes.
- Scope:
  - Introduce a Katana execution adapter with two crawl modes:
    - unauthenticated baseline crawl
    - authenticated crawl using target profile headers/cookies and extension-captured auth context (when available)
  - Implement/ship a small Go wrapper service that uses Katana library APIs (`types.Options`, standard/hybrid engine) and streams normalized JSONL results back to API.
  - Add backend orchestration in recon pipeline:
    - submit Katana run
    - consume result stream
    - extract JS candidates + source map candidates
    - dedupe + scope enforcement
    - ingest/analyze via existing `/api/save-files` path.
  - Persist run metadata and crawl provenance for each captured asset (`crawler=katana`, `mode`, `depth`, `parent`, `status_code`, `content_type`, `source`).
  - Add operator controls: max depth, timeout, strategy, scope field, known-files mode, JavaScript crawl parsing toggle, headless mode.
- Out of Scope:
  - Replacing existing Playwright recon runner.
  - Full workspace UX redesign (`B-015`).
  - Secret scanner replacement (TruffleHog remains `B-014`).
- Planned File Changes:
  - `api/app/services/katana_client.py` (new, API <-> wrapper transport)
  - `api/app/services/recon_job_runner.py` (integrate katana discovery strategy)
  - `api/app/api/routes/recon.py` (new katana start/list/status/stop payload fields)
  - `api/app/models/` additions for durable crawl-run metadata (if required by selected design)
  - `api/app/static/dashboard.js` and `api/app/templates/dashboard.html` (Katana launch controls + run status)
  - `api/docker-compose.yml` (katana wrapper service wiring, env, network, healthcheck)
  - `katana-runner/` (new Go module using Katana library)
  - `api/tests/test_b030_katana_recon_contract.py` (new)
  - `api/tests/test_b030_katana_recon_integration.py` (new, wrapper mocked)
- Data/Schema Changes:
  - Preferred: add durable run records (`recon_runs`) and optional per-asset run links (`recon_run_assets`) for restart-safe observability.
  - Minimum fallback: attach Katana provenance in `files.file_metadata`.
- API Contract Changes:
  - Extend recon start payload with `crawler: "playwright" | "katana"` and katana-specific options.
  - Add katana run metadata in job status response (`crawler`, `crawlMode`, `katanaOptions`, `seedUrls`, `discoveryStats`).
- Risks:
  - Katana hybrid mode auth behavior may vary by site and cookies/headers; authenticated coverage must be explicitly validated.
  - New Go wrapper introduces build/runtime dependency and interface versioning risk.
  - Large crawl output can overload ingestion unless bounded with strict limits/backpressure.
- Rollback Plan:
  - Feature-flag Katana strategy behind env toggle.
  - Revert to existing recon flow by disabling `crawler=katana`.
  - Keep wrapper isolated so service can be removed without breaking current recon API.
- Test Plan:
  - Static checks:
    - `python3 -m py_compile` for new backend modules.
    - `go test ./...` for wrapper module.
  - Task-specific tests:
    - request validation for katana options + mode fields.
    - contract tests for run lifecycle and normalized result payload.
    - dedupe/idempotency tests when katana emits duplicate asset URLs.
  - Integration tests:
    - mocked katana stream -> ingestion -> analysis completion path.
    - authenticated mode test with supplied cookie/header profile.

    - rerun `api/tests/test_b011_recon_job_api.py` and `api/tests/test_t005_upload_response.py`.

- Summary: Add Analyze-All configuration modal so each run has explicit options before execution, with persistent user defaults and transparent run context.
- Scope:
  - Added Analyze-All modal (`Quick Run` + `Start Advanced Run`) with explicit controls for analysis type, extractor toggles, sourcemap/include-reconstructed toggles, failure policy, and runtime bounds.
  - Rewired session Analyze-All button to open modal instead of immediately starting a run.
  - Implemented modal submit pipeline to send selected options to `/api/sessions/{session_id}/analyze/start`.
  - Persist advanced defaults in `localStorage` and preload them when reopening the modal.
  - Added progress-context badges so active/completed jobs show run mode/type/maps/policy at a glance.
  - Hardened backend option normalization/echo behavior (preserve `submitted_at`, consistent option shape in `job.options`).
- Out of Scope:
  - Changing extraction algorithms.
  - Global policy engine for org-wide defaults.
- Implemented File Changes:
  - `api/app/templates/dashboard.html`
  - `api/app/static/dashboard.js`
  - `api/app/static/dashboard.css`
  - `api/app/api/routes/sessions.py`
  - `api/tests/test_b031_session_analyze_config_contract.py`
- Data/Schema Changes:
  - None required for v1; use client-side persisted defaults.
- API Contract Changes:
  - `/api/sessions/{session_id}/analyze/start` now explicitly supports modal option contract (camelCase/snake_case aliases normalized server-side).
  - Async analysis job payloads include normalized `job.options` for traceability.
  - `max_files_to_analyze`, `continue_on_error`, and `max_failures` are now enforced in session execution flow.
- Risks:
  - Progress option context for historical idle sessions remains unavailable (`job.options = null` when no active/completed in-memory job snapshot exists).
  - Frontend unit test harness for modal behavior was not added in this task; behavior is covered via API contract tests and static checks.
- Rollback Plan:
  - Keep one-click fallback path behind feature flag.
  - Revert modal wiring while preserving existing analyze endpoint.
- Test Plan:

- Summary: Stabilize Sessions tab UX at scale by reducing re-render churn and introducing high-density navigation/filtering patterns for active analysis workloads.
- Scope:
  - Add server-side pagination + filtering to sessions endpoint (`page`, `pageSize`, `status`, `search`, `coverageBucket`).
  - Implement virtualized/incremental row rendering in Sessions tab and row-level patch updates only.
  - Add sticky control bar (search, status filters, sort, bulk actions, auto-refresh toggle/interval).
  - Add visual hierarchy for “active”, “needs attention”, and “completed” session groups.
  - Improve polling strategy:
    - debounce refresh
    - pause background refresh when tab hidden
    - coalesce in-flight requests.
- Out of Scope:
  - Full mapper workspace replacement (`B-015`).
  - Any analysis-engine changes.
- Planned File Changes:
  - `api/app/api/routes/sessions.py` (pagination/filter query params and response shape)
  - `api/app/static/dashboard.js` (virtualization, grouped rendering, polling hardening)
  - `api/app/static/dashboard.css` (sticky controls, density classes, state indicators)
  - `api/app/templates/dashboard.html` (sessions toolbar/pagination controls)
  - `api/tests/test_b032_sessions_pagination_contract.py` (new)
  - `api/tests/test_b032_sessions_ui_stability.mjs` (new)
- Data/Schema Changes:
  - None required.
- API Contract Changes:
  - `GET /api/sessions` gains pagination/filter query parameters and paged response metadata (`total`, `page`, `pageSize`, `hasNext`).
- Risks:
  - Pagination contract change can break existing UI callers if not backward-compatible.
  - Virtualization bugs can hide actions/state if row identity handling is wrong.
- Rollback Plan:
  - Keep legacy list mode behind feature flag.
  - Roll back paginated response and keep old response shape if client issues occur.
- Test Plan:
  - Static checks for Python and frontend scripts.
  - Task-specific tests for pagination/filter API contract and frontend render stability.
  - Cross-agent compatibility:
    - rerun `api/tests/test_t023_dashboard_failure_utils.mjs` and `api/tests/test_t021_session_analyze_progress.py`.
  - Manual validation:
    - stress test with 500+ sessions and active analyses to confirm no UI glitching/focus loss.

## ID: IMP-B017
- Task ID: B-017
- Owner: AGENT_A (CODEX)
- Status: IMPLEMENTED
- Created: 2026-02-10T22:28:24Z
- Last Updated: 2026-02-10T22:41:39Z
- Summary: Capture per-request auth context in the extension, persist it with uploaded file metadata, and replay allowlisted auth headers on backend sourcemap fetch fallback for authenticated targets.
- Scope:
  - Extension:
    - Add request-header capture listener for script requests.
    - Build strict auth-context payload (`schemaVersion`, `domain`, `requestUrl`, `capturedAt`, allowlisted headers, cookie presence metadata).
    - Add per-domain auth-context controls in settings (`captureAuthContext`, `authContextDomains`).
    - Attach auth-context object to uploaded file payload.
  - Backend:
    - Add `authContext` support on ingestion payload schema.
    - Sanitize/normalize auth context with allowlist, header length caps, and same-domain replay constraints.
    - Use sanitized replay headers as sourcemap fetch fallback when direct fetch fails with auth-related errors.
    - Keep API output redacted for auth context when returning file metadata.
  - Tests:
    - Add task-specific tests for auth-context sanitization and replay fallback behavior.
- Out of Scope:
  - Persisting browser auth profiles globally for non-extension crawlers.
  - Full credential vault management/rotation.
  - Header/cookie capture for non-script requests.
- Planned File Changes:
  - `chrome-extension/background.js`
  - `chrome-extension/options.html`
  - `chrome-extension/options.js`
  - `api/app/services/auth_context.py` (new)
  - `api/app/api/routes/ingestion.py`
  - `api/app/api/routes/files.py`
  - `api/tests/test_b017_auth_context_replay.py` (new)
  - `TODO.md`, `IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.md`, `APPLICATION_OVERVIEW.md`
- Completed File Changes:
  - `chrome-extension/background.js` (request auth-context capture listener + per-domain scope checks + payload attachment)
  - `chrome-extension/options.html` (auth-context controls)
  - `chrome-extension/options.js` (persist/load/reset auth-context settings)
  - `api/app/services/auth_context.py` (new sanitization/redaction/replay helpers)
  - `api/app/api/routes/ingestion.py` (authContext schema + sourcemap auth replay fallback)
  - `api/app/api/routes/files.py` (metadata auth-context redaction for output)
  - `api/tests/test_b017_auth_context_replay.py` (new)
  - `README.md`
  - `APPLICATION_OVERVIEW.md`
  - `TODO.md`
  - `COMPLETED_TASKS.md`
  - `IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.md`
- Data/Schema Changes:
  - No DB migration planned; auth context stored within existing `files.file_metadata` JSONB.
- API Contract Changes:
  - `/api/save-files` accepts optional `files[].authContext`.
  - `GET /api/files/{file_id}` continues returning `metadata`, but auth-context header values are redacted in response payload.
- UI/UX Changes:
  - New options controls for auth-context capture and domain scoping.
  - Better sourcemap success on authenticated targets without manual backend header setup.
- Risks:
  - Over-capturing sensitive headers if allowlist or scope checks are wrong.
  - Browser API differences for request-header visibility can reduce capture rate on some requests.
  - Replaying stale auth context may still fail (expired session tokens/cookies).
- Rollback Plan:
  - Disable capture with `captureAuthContext=false`.
  - Revert backend replay fallback to direct unauthenticated fetch only.
  - Keep sourcemap processing functional through existing uploaded `sourceMapContent` path.
- Test Plan:

    - `docker compose -f api/docker-compose.yml exec -T api sh -lc "uv run python -m pytest -q /tmp/test_b017_auth_context_replay.py"`
  - Cross-agent compatibility:

## ID: IMP-B012

- Summary: Implement persisted sourcemap validation lifecycle fields and session-level coverage metrics to remove ambiguity around map detection/fetch/processing outcomes.
- Scope:
  - Persist per-file sourcemap validation lifecycle (`detected`, `fetched`, `http_status`, `content_type`, `json_valid`, `processed`) in the `source_maps` record.
  - Extend sourcemap serializers so file/session APIs expose lifecycle state.
  - Add `GET /api/sessions/{session_id}/sourcemap-validation` with denominator clarity and grouped failure reasons.
  - Add Files-tab summary panel showing sourcemap coverage KPIs and failure reason breakdown for current scope.
  - Add per-file lifecycle row text in View Files so operators can quickly verify expected sourcemap flow.
- Out of Scope:
  - Full mapper workspace UI redesign.
  - Extension capture behavior changes.
  - New background jobs for sourcemap retries.
- Planned File Changes:
  - `api/app/models/source_map.py`: add persisted lifecycle JSON field.
  - `api/app/main.py`: runtime schema update for lifecycle column.
  - `api/app/services/native_sourcemap_processor.py`: expose fetch metadata from map retrieval.
  - `api/app/api/routes/ingestion.py`: write lifecycle values during detection/fetch/process steps.
  - `api/app/api/routes/sessions.py`: add session sourcemap validation endpoint and lifecycle serialization.
  - `api/app/api/routes/files.py`: include lifecycle fields in file sourcemap payload.
  - `api/app/static/dashboard.js`: render sourcemap coverage panel + per-file lifecycle badges/line.
  - `api/app/templates/dashboard.html`: add Files-tab summary container.
  - `api/app/static/dashboard.css`: styling for new coverage/lifecycle elements.
  - `api/tests/test_b012_sourcemap_validation_metrics.py`: endpoint + lifecycle aggregation tests.
- Data/Schema Changes:
  - Add `source_maps.validation_state` JSON column (nullable) for lifecycle persistence.
- API Contract Changes:
  - Add `sourceMap.validation` object to file/session sourcemap payloads.
  - Add `GET /api/sessions/{session_id}/sourcemap-validation`.
- UI/UX Changes:
  - Files tab shows explicit sourcemap coverage counters and top failure classes.
  - Each file row shows lifecycle clarity (detected/fetched/json-valid/processed + HTTP status).
- Risks:
  - Existing records without lifecycle data require fallback derivation from legacy fields.
  - Lifecycle values derived from processing errors may be partial for legacy records.

    - MAP URL: `https://wishandwash.co.il/assets/index-BDSyL5Fh.js.map`
